knowledgeAnswers.rationale: Acids can etch marble and similar natural stone, so acid is unsuitable for those surfaces.
Testing follows the procedure and the result is judged once the area has dried.
Mixing products can produce hazardous reactions, which is why each product is used on its own.
The match the soil to the method section says soap film is usually removed with a mild, compatible detergent.

practicalCriteria: Identifies six fixture materials and selects an approved product and tool for each.
Justifies at least two exclusions, citing the material or the soil.
Does not use an abrasive or acidic product on a sensitive finish during the practical.
passRule: All six fixtures matched with a justified product and at least two justified exclusions, with no sensitive-finish damage in the practical. Observed by an assessor.
stopWorkCriteria: Requested product is known to be unsuitable for the surface
